verdict.rationale: Windmill's own docs and repo describe flows assembled from code scripts, with TypeScript and Python among the supported languages, and workflows-as-code in TypeScript or Python. Writing real code as a flow step is the product's core model. Missing for 10: plain JavaScript (as opposed to TypeScript) step support is not stated explicitly, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of authoring code steps inside flows.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop into real code (JavaScript or Python) as a step inside a workflow

citations.quote: It supports coding in TypeScript, Python, Go, PHP, Bash, C#, SQL, Rust, Ruby and R, or any Docker image
An orchestrator for assembling these functions into efficient, low-latency flows, using either a low-code builder or YAML
Scripts are turned into sharable UIs automatically, and can be composed together into flows
Workflows as code let you define orchestration logic directly in TypeScript or Python
